summary: Citibank Credit Card Issuance Trust, Citibank Credit Card Master Trust I, and Citibank N.A. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 Other Events to disclose the loss and delinquency experience for credit card receivables. The filing reports net loss percentages for cardholder payments on a cash basis for the three months ended. No transaction, corporate event, or special situation is present; it is a routine periodic disclosure of asset performance for an asset-backed securities trust. No deal terms, board actions, or strategic changes are involved.
